title: Inside Knight Transportation’s Reno Terminal: Where Drivers Build Relationships and Maximize Home Time
summary: Discover what makes Knight Transportation's Reno Terminal unique, from strong driver relationships and home time opportunities to consistent California freight lanes.
body_markdown:
If you’re searching for[truck driving jobs in Reno](https://www.knighttrans.com/jobs/) or a terminal that supports your career goals and home life, Knight Transportation’s Reno Terminal is worth a closer look.


In our new Reno Terminal Video, you’ll meet the people behind the operation. You’ll learn what makes this location stand out. From strong driver-manager relationships to consistent freight opportunities, Reno helps drivers maximize home time. Additionally, you’ll get a firsthand look at the supportive, family-like culture the Reno team has built.


Whether you’re a seasoned driver or just starting your[CDL journey](https://www.knighttrans.com/cdl-training/) , discover what makes the Reno Terminal unique.


## Why Reno Prioritizes Strong Driver Relationships


The[Reno Terminal](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/reno-nv/) is often known as Knight Transportation’s “biggest little terminal.” While the terminal continues to grow, one thing remains the same: its commitment to building strong relationships with drivers.


At Reno, drivers are[never a number](https://youtu.be/rokiY8Tv1xc?si=BZCZ4UxbJP18Lbh5) . The operations team works hard to create an environment where drivers feel supported, valued, and heard.


According to Terminal Manager Victor Marquez-Molina, those relationships are central to the terminal’s culture.


“My drivers have a tight relationship with their driver managers. They feel comfortable bringing any issue to us, whether it’s personal or related to the business. They count on us to find a resolution.”


That support extends beyond freight and schedules.


As a result, drivers know they have a team that genuinely cares about their success both on and off the road.


> "We know our drivers. We want to know about their personal lives. We're here for them. That's one of the reasons why I love being here at Knight Transportation. It's family."
>
>
> Stacey Meyers, Reno Driver Manager


## A Terminal Focused on Home Time


Home time is one of the most important priorities for drivers and their families. After all, time spent at home creates opportunities to rest and recharge.


Fortunately, Reno’s freight network helps make home time more achievable for many drivers.


Most of Reno’s freight moves to and from Southern California. Because of those consistent freight lanes, the team can often create schedules that support drivers’ home time needs.


[Dedicated](https://www.knighttrans.com/our-services/?services_description_tab=4#services_description) Reno Driver Carlos Gonzalez has experienced that firsthand.


Before joining Knight Transportation, Carlos served overseas in the Marine Corps and spent long periods away from his family. Today, his dedicated route allows him to be home every weekend.


“It’s just amazing that I’m able to do that now.”


Stories like Carlos’ reflect Reno’s commitment to helping drivers balance their careers and personal lives whenever possible.


[Knight Transportation](https://www.knighttrans.com/about-us/) understands the sacrifices drivers make every day. Therefore, the Reno operations team works hard to help drivers get home when they need it most.


## Convenient Access to California Freight


Another advantage of the Reno Terminal is its proximity to Northern California.


Located just a few hours away, Reno provides access to freight opportunities throughout both Northern and Southern California. As a result, the operations team can move freight efficiently while helping California-based drivers stay closer to home.


Some of its key markets include:


- Southern California
- Northern California
- Salt Lake City
- Las Vegas
- Portland


This strategic location benefits both the business and the drivers who depend on consistent miles and reliable home time.
